messages:
alyssa: Quick sync — want to lock dry-run + run-of-show for the panel we discussed. Panel format, 3 speakers + 1 moderator, 40min content + 15min live Q&A. Proposed rehearsal window: Tue 10/7 or Wed 10/8 11:00-12:00 PT. Can people confirm availability?

michael: I can do Tue 10/7. Can we please also confirm who will moderate? Prefer an external-sounding moderator (neutral) for better audience trust.

devon: Tue works for me. I'll own the demo env and 1-minute failover script in case live demo fails.

sophia: Wed 10/8 is slightly better for ops (infra team on rotation that week), but I can shift. Need the Zoom co-host list 48h before rehearsal so SRE can be co-host.

jamie: Confirming Tue 10/7 for me. On the comms side: landing page + registration needs to go live by next Monday, and we need the benchmark blurb + hero stat for the hero banner. Draft CTA: "Reserve your seat — see inference at 1/3rd the cost" (open to wording).

kate: I'll schedule the dry-run and send calendar invites. Who's the recording owner? Zoom recording + asset storage in GDrive. Also add a short checklist for A/V: mic test, slides share, stage order.

alyssa: Moderator idea: @michael to moderate? Or we could invite @sophia as neutral convener. Michael — you can moderate or nominate someone external?

michael: Happy to moderate but would prefer to focus on the quick opening and the most strategic questions. Devon can take the longer technical deep-dive. Jamie — can we get a short panel brief (one-liner per speaker + 2 bullets of talking points)?

jamie: On it. I'll draft speaker blurb + talking points by EOD tomorrow. Also propose 2 poll questions to run live: 1) "Biggest LLM serving pain point" (latency / cost / reliability / scaling) 2) "Current deployment mode" (hosted / dedicated / private).

devon: Demo plan: 6-minute interactive demo showing latency differences and a fallback scenario. Backup: pre-recorded short clip saved to GDrive "webinar-assets/demo-fallback.mp4". Ops runbook snippet for dry-run:
```
- 5m before: host opens webinar, co-host checks audio/video
- 3m before: start pre-roll slide + poll 1
- 0m: host intro (2m), moderator intro (1m), speaker 1 (8m), speaker 2 (8m), demo (6m), lightning slides (5m)
- Last 15m: live Q&A moderated + closing CTA
```

sophia: Ops notes: please add SRE as co-host and list SRE's GSuite email in the invite. We will enable recording and cloud transcript. Also whitelist the Zoom recording URL in company policy.

alyssa: Marketing copy note: need benchmark narrative paragraph (60-80 words) emphasizing cost/latency tradeoffs and Redwood Optimize recommendations. Example seed: "See how teams cut inference token costs by 40% using batching, caching, and model selection — with no noticeable latency regression." Keep it non-promotional but results-focused.

jamie: Draft landing page hero lines: (1) "Serving LLMs — Faster, Cheaper, More Predictable" (2) CTA: "Join the live panel". I'll circulate two variants for A/B. Also need speaker headshots and 2-sentence bios by EOD Friday.

kate: Calendar invite scheduled: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (tentative Tue 10/7 11:00-12:00 PT). I added Zoom co-host: alyssa@redwood.com, devon@redwood.com, sophia@redwood.com, kate@redwood.com. Zoom-bot: please confirm recording is enabled.

zoom-bot: Recording enabled for meeting (ID: 890-1234). Cloud transcript ON. Recording will be saved to GDrive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xyz.

alyssa: Inbound lead routing: final form to HubSpot needs hidden field "webinar_topic=llm-serving-panel" + tag "marketing:webinar_oct". Post-webinar, ops to trigger lead scoring rule: if attended -> assign to AE queue A, else send nurture sequence. Devon — can you confirm the event property we should use to gate demo access for attendees?

devon: Use property `redwood_webinar_attended=true`. We'll map that from Zoom attendance report to HubSpot via Zapier. Also create short script to add a TTL (30 days) that unlocks demo access token.

michael: For the benchmark deck slide — let's include 1 chart showing latency distribution pre/post caching and one table with cost-per-1k tokens. Jamie, include a clear legend and source note.

jamie: Will do. Also planning a short post-webinar nurture: 1) Thanks + recording, 2) Technical appendix + benchmark report (PDF gated), 3) CTA for dedicated trial or private consult. Sequence over 14 days.

sophia: Dry-run checklist for infra: share stub logs and example request IDs we can use during demo. We'll generate small synthetic traffic to validate KV cache behavior.

alyssa: ACTIONS: Kate to finalize invite + co-hosts (today). Jamie to deliver hero copy, poll q's, speaker bios (EOD Fri). Michael to confirm moderator path (this week). Devon to prep demo + fallback clip (EOD Mon). Sophia to confirm SRE co-host & recording policy (48h before). Everyone please react :thumbsup: when you've completed your action. We'll run the dry-run on Tue 10/7 11:00-12:00 PT unless someone objects by EOD today.
